changes.foreground_band_support: A foreground cutoff now requires aggregate support from complete depth clusters inside the configured 60 mm band; a weak leaf sliver cannot truncate a supported fruit surface behind it.
changes.cluster_preservation: Foreground rejection masks complete depth clusters instead of slicing a continuous surface at a scalar threshold, preventing low-MAD pseudo-layers.
changes.geometry_conflict_window: The generalized-only support conflict window is 40 mm. A candidate still wins only with at least twice the runner-up support; similarly supported layers remain ambiguous and fail closed.
changes.bearing_source: The base localizer now uses the detector box centre for ray bearing while depth-layer evidence supplies range, matching the existing wrist behavior and reducing one-sided occlusion bias.
changes.unchanged_gates: The 15 mm base and wrist uncertainty gates, 50 mm wrist correction gate, 20 mm clearance gate, collision checks, and dual-contact attachment verification were not relaxed.
